Question: If you bring out Ambrogino (ADV) and turn him anarch, what
happens when you then merge him with Ambrogino (regular)?

Note: Cannot do it the other way (easily that is) because Ambrogino
(regular) has 1 vote.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
<adam....@ngc.com> wrote:
> Question: If you bring out Ambrogino (ADV) and turn him anarch, what
> happens when you then merge him with Ambrogino (regular)?

He merges.
He's still anarch.
